input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and Sections 21.2–21.3 contain the exclusion of indirect damages, the full Excluded Claims carve-out list and the payment-obligations carve-out. However, one month of Fees actually paid is well below the 6-month walk-away floor, and "without exception" purports to override the Excluded Claims. We reset the basis to the greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1,000,000 and restored the carve-out.

input.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains only a broad one-way Customer indemnity and no Vendor IP or misconduct indemnity anywhere in the document (Section 9.3 even cross-refers to non-existent Section 20.5 remedies), which is walk-away territory. We added the Vendor indemnity with standard procedure and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law.

input.quote: 12.4 During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
input.rationale: A 24-month post-term restriction of undefined scope in any territory is walk-away, with no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3; we have deleted it.

input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Exclusive dealing for the full three-year term with no performance-based exit is walk-away, and it conflicts with Section 12.3's statement that we made no exclusivity commitment. Deleted, with a 12-month performance-linked fallback offered.
